recommended_application: First substantive film mention: Odia form (existing English title), preserving Latin discoverability.
Profile headings may pair both forms once; avoid every repeated mention.
Keep bibliography titles verbatim; do not rewrite source record titles.
Odia script does not establish Odia-language identity: label Manto, Ankur and other non-Odia works as transliterations.
Normalize Unicode consistently; do not silently replace ଲ with ଳ or vowel length when sources conflict.
Preserve existing image alt/caption provenance text unless root explicitly revises.
not_complete: All28 entries now have usable paired display forms. Some are explicitly editorial transliterations/attested house variants rather than original-credit spellings; no exclusive-original typography claims.
exact_replacement_rules: Replace first substantive body mention per article only; for a film-profile article also pair its heading once.
Keep existing DAMaN capitalization when replacing DAMaN: *ଦମନ (DAMaN)*.
Use *ମାୟା ମିରିଗ (Māyā Miriga)* only where that accented Latin form already occurs.
Do not replace within URLs, source titles, image filenames, frontmatter source records, footnotes or repeated prose automatically.
Use for non-Odia films as a readable script rendering; do not label any of these as an original Odia film title.
Spacing normalization such as ଶୀତରାତି versus ଶୀତ ରାତି is an editorial choice, not a new film identity.
